item.title: UK rejoins Erasmus+ programme from 2027
item.description: French students will once again be able to use the Erasmus+ programme to study, intern or train in the United Kingdom from 1st January 2027.

item.title: What’s behind Monaco’s record-breaking resale boom and property trends in 2025?
item.description: Which districts broke records, which buildings drove the boom — and what does it all mean for Monaco's property market?

item.title: Cyrielle Dailly – the baby sleep whisperer brings American know-how to Monaco
item.description: When Cyrielle Dailly's second son refused to sleep, she did what any exhausted mother would do: desperately searched for answers. What she found was something that would change not only her own life, but the lives of thousands of parents struggling with their baby's sleep.

item.title: Prince’s Palace extends 2026 opening dates for the public
item.description: Monaco's Prince's Palace will reopen to the public on 30th March, offering visitors nearly seven months to explore the State Apartments and their recently restored Renaissance frescoes.

item.title: Two lucky Monaco students could have the opportunity of a lifetime in the Arctic
item.description: Two students from Monaco are set to join an Arctic expedition this summer, following the launch of the 16th edition of the Students on Ice programme.

item.title: Jardin du Chemin des Sculptures set for major transformation
item.description: Fontvieille’s Jardin du Chemin des Sculptures is set for a major green transformation, with phased works beginning this month to create a cooler, more inviting space focused on shade, biodiversity and sustainable design.

item.title: Nuclear revival and renewables surge in France’s €60bn energy reset
item.description: France has unveiled its third multiyear energy plan, setting out a bold vision to move the country away from fossil fuels and expand electricity production over the next decade.

item.title: Discount tickets and teaser video released for landmark Monaco and the Automobile exhibition
item.description: The Grimaldi Forum Monaco has opened pre-sale ticketing and released a teaser video for Monaco and the Automobile, from 1893 to the Present Day, the most ambitious automotive exhibition ever staged in the Principality.

item.title: Princess Charlene-backed Saint Dévote Tournament set for most international edition yet
item.description: The Stade Louis II will swap football for rugby on the 20th and 21st March, when Monaco hosts the 14th edition of the Saint Dévote Tournament, one of the largest under 12s international rugby competitions in the world.

item.title: ‘Mona in Monaco’: new electronic music festival for Monaco
item.description: A new electronic music festival is coming to Monaco, with the first edition of Mona in Wonderland set to take place at the Chapiteau de l'Espace Fontvieille on Saturday 30th May.
